title: 第11章 超凡散尽回归平庸第12章 火系能量
slug: 我金丹呢你当结石摘出来了
lines: 三天后。
夜色沉沉，江城的六月夜晚带着一丝清凉，风从城东的河面上吹过来，穿过街巷，拂动行道树的枝叶，发出沙沙的细响。
城西，老旧居民区，一楼。
王明家的灯还亮着。
这是一套两室一厅的老房子，墙皮有些泛黄，客厅里摆着一张老式沙发和一台不大的电视机，茶几上放着几盒术后恢复期的药物，旁边还有一袋没吃完的水果。
王明坐在沙发上，穿着一件宽松的t恤，手里拿着手机在刷短视频。
这就是那个在诊室里问“哥，真不是金丹”的大学生。
术后恢复得不错，腰部的穿刺创口已经愈合的差不多了，复查的b超显示肾脏形态正常，积水消退，各项指标都在正常范围内。
从医学角度来说，他已经痊愈了。
但王明总觉得怪怪的，然而又不知道从何说起。
手术之前那段时间，虽然腰部有着明显的疼痛，但他的脑袋格外清醒，清醒到一种不正常的程度，上课的时候，老师讲的内容他几乎能过耳不忘，做题的速度比以前快了一倍不止，甚至有一种奇妙的错觉，周围的一切都仿佛在他的感觉下变得更慢了，同学们说话的语速、走路的节奏、甚至风吹过窗帘的动作，都变得细腻而温和。
那种感觉很奇妙。
像是世界给他开了一个特殊的滤镜。
但是现在，腰不痛了，不适感也消失了。
那种神奇的感觉，也随之消失了。
他又变回了那个普普通通的大学生。
王明放下手机，盯着天花板发了一会儿呆。
“儿子。”
厨房里传来他妈的声音。
“你给学校请的假差不多了吧？身体恢复得也差不多了，到时候可以回学校里去了，学业可不能荒废了，供出你这么个大学生可不容易。”
“好。”王明心不在焉的应了一声。
他妈又唠叨了几句注意身体之类的话，王明嗯嗯啊啊地应着，然后起身回了自己的房间。
关灯。
屋子暗了下来，只剩下窗外路灯透进来的一点昏黄光线。
窗外，一棵老槐树的枝杈间，苏业收回了目光。
他蹲在一根粗壮的树枝上，身体稳稳当当的，夜风吹动他的衣角，他却纹丝不动，这要是放在一周前，他绝对做不到这种事，在这里已经蹲了不知多久了，身体平稳，状态良好，一点麻的感觉都没有。
而苏业的手里拿着一个巴掌大的小册子，上面密密麻麻地写满了字。
这三天时间，苏业通过各种手段对王明进行了持续观察。
以规培生的身份打电话询问术后恢复情况，这是正常的随访流程，不会引起任何怀疑，又在下班后亲自来到王明家附近，远距离观察他的日常行动、精神状态、体能表现。
三天的观察，结果很明确。
苏业翻开小册子，借着路灯的微光看了一眼自己写的总结。
“金丹雏形的出现，让王明感受到了不适，这是异变出现后的第一反应，金丹雏形在肾部结晶，属于水系进化方向，有助于精神方向的进化，而王明所感受到的疼痛和不适，是金丹雏形在对宿主进行同化，或者说是促进进化。”
“同化期间，宿主会获得对应属性的增益，王明的水系金丹对应精神系，所以他在那段时间思维变快、感知变敏锐、记忆力增强。”
“现在金丹雏形被摘除，同化中断，宿主从异变状态回归正常。”
“王明身上的特异性增益已经完全消失。”
content_en:
Three days later.
The night was dark, and the June night in Jiangcheng was a bit cool. The wind blew from the river in the east of the city, passing through the streets and alleys, stirring the branches and leaves of the street trees, making a soft rustling sound.
West of the city, old residential area, first floor.
The lights in Wang Ming's house are still on.
This is an old house with two bedrooms and one living room. The walls are somewhat yellowed. There is an old-fashioned sofa and a small TV set in the living room. There are several boxes of post-operative recovery drugs on the coffee table, and there is a bag of uneaten fruit next to it.
Wang Ming was sitting on the sofa, wearing a loose T-shirt, holding his mobile phone in his hand and watching short videos.
This is the college student who asked in the clinic, "Brother, is this really not a golden elixir?"
I recovered well after the operation, and the puncture wound on my waist has almost healed. The B-ultrasound of the follow-up examination showed that the shape of the kidneys was normal, the water accumulation had subsided, and all indicators were within the normal range.
Medically speaking, he is cured.
But Wang Ming always felt strange, but he didn't know where to start.
During the period before the surgery, although there was obvious pain in his waist, his head was extremely clear, sober to an abnormal level. During class, he could almost never forget what the teacher said, and he could solve problems more than twice as fast as before. He even had a wonderful illusion that everything around him seemed to slow down under his feeling. The speed of his classmates' speaking, the rhythm of walking, and even the movement of the wind blowing through the curtains became delicate and gentle.
That feeling is amazing.
It's like the world has opened a special filter for him.
But now, my waist no longer hurts and the discomfort has disappeared.
That magical feeling also disappeared.
He became that ordinary college student again.
Wang Ming put down his phone and stared at the ceiling for a while.
"Son."
There was a fucking sound coming from the kitchen.
"Have you almost taken the leave from school? Your body has almost recovered. You can go back to school by then. Don't let your studies go to waste. It's not easy to confess a college student like you."
"Okay." Wang Ming responded absently.
His mother nagged a few more words about taking care of your body, etc. Wang Ming agreed, then got up and went back to his room.
Turn off the lights.
The house darkened, leaving only a little dim light coming from the street lamp outside the window.
…
Outside the window, among the branches of an old locust tree, Su ye withdrew his gaze.
He squatted on a thick branch, his body steady. The night wind blew the corners of his clothes, but he did not move at all. A week ago, he would never have been able to do this. He had been squatting here for an unknown amount of time. His body was stable and in good condition, and he did not feel any numbness at all.
Su ye held a palm-sized booklet in his hand, which was densely filled with words.
During the past three days, Su ye continued to observe Wang Ming through various means.
As a regular trainee, he called to inquire about his postoperative recovery. This was a normal follow-up procedure and would not arouse any suspicion. He also personally came to Wang Ming's home after get off work to observe his daily actions, mental state, and physical performance from a distance.
After three days of observation, the results are clear.
Su ye opened the booklet and took a look at the summary he had written in the dim light of the street lamp.
"The emergence of the prototype of the golden elixir made Wang Ming feel uncomfortable. This was the first reaction after the mutation occurred. The prototype of the golden elixir crystallized in the kidneys, which belongs to the direction of water system evolution and contributes to the evolution of the spiritual direction. The pain and discomfort Wang Ming felt was because the prototype of the golden elixir was assimilating the host, or in other words, promoting evolution."
"During the assimilation period, the host will gain corresponding attribute gains. Wang Ming's water-based golden elixir corresponds to the spiritual system, so during that period, his thinking will become faster, his perception will become sharper, and his memory will be enhanced."
"Now the golden elixir prototype has been removed, assimilation is interrupted, and the host returns to normal from the mutated state."
"The specific gain on Wang Ming has completely disappeared."
